The Omnia Mystics are a squad of Shado-Pan magic users coordinated by Ban Bearheart, part of the larger Omnia discipline within the order. They are based out of the Shado-Pan Garrison, fighting mogu and their minions on the island of Shan'ze Dao. Shado-Pan daily quests rotate through sets of quests for the Mystics, the Blackguard Defenders, and the Wu Kao Assassins on different days. When the Mystics are active, heroes may ask one of them (other than Bearheart) to accompany them on the day's missions. They fulfill caster roles using both divine and arcane magic.

Orb of Synchronized Power can be obtained for free from Bronze Brannbeard during Legion Remix PTR testing. It sets the character's Infinite Power to a specific amount based on their level. At level 80, it sets Infinite Power to a total of 130,000―enough to fill out the main portion of the artifact, but not to get any ranks of Limits Unbound.

Orta is a world boss located in the Old Sacrificial Pit at the Skeins in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet. It will only be available while the world quest Orta, the Broken Mountain is active, once every four weeks. The Deathbringer plaque mentions something called "the Hollow Mountain" being defeated by the nerubians. This may have been Orta's capture.
Overburdened Valets are blood elves accompanying Silvermoon Nobles in the Promenade in the Royal Exchange and in the Walk of Elders in Silvermoon City.
The Path of the Grand Magistrix is a reward from Keystone Hero: Court of Stars. It teleports the user to the entrance of the Court of Stars.
The Path of Nerubian Ascension is a reward from Keystone Hero: City of Threads. It teleports the user to the entrance of the City of Threads.

The Path of Dawn is the road through northern Eversong Woods to Silvermoon City, along the former path of the Dead Scar. It begins at the Tranquil Repose near the East Sanctum, and runs through Silvermoon's gates to the Bazaar.

The Peacekeepers are the guardians of Dornogal, they protect the city from all threats, foreign and domestic. They also provide assistance and render aid to their fellow citizens and foreign travelers. They are not charged with the defense of the Isle of Dorn as a whole. That responsibility falls to the Stormriders. Peacekeepers are required to stay and serve within the limits of Dornogal. Over the years however, some peacekeepers, like Aggartha and Leif, have felt the need to venture forth beyond the city to fulfill their purpose. It teleports the character to the Millennia's Threshold, which contains portals to the dungeons across Azeroth and beyond for Mythic+ in the current PvE season. It requires max level to use it.

Primal Philosopher's Stone is an alchemist stone made with Midnight Alchemy. The ability to make this item can be learned after leveling Midnight Alchemy to 10 and then interacting with Camberon's Cauldron in Silvermoon City. Unlocking the recipe costs 5 Stabilized Derivate.

The Ravel ( ) was an organization made of the brightest minds in K'aresh who sought to save their world from Dimensius during the Devouring War. Most K'areshi believe the void lord was responsible for their planet's destruction. In truth, the Ravel attempted to preemptively kill Dimensius before he could consume K'aresh, knowing there was no other way to stop him, and shattered the planet in the process.

Saristrasz was the majordomo of Alexstrasza. He was among the primal dragons who chose to accept ordering and became a member of the red dragonflight because he felt dragonkind was stronger working together. Despite having previously been a primal dragon himself, he remarked that Vyranoth spoke well for one of her kind. The Silversun Compact is the union of the Sunreaver blood elves and the high elves of the Silver Covenant. In the wake of Dalaran's destruction and the loss of the Sunwell, the elven factions, once at odds in Dalaran, were prompted to disband and unite in Silvermoon. The Compact vows to forgo vengeance when Azeroth is imperilled and to share the might, magic, and wisdom needed to craft war to meet such threats, that the practitioners of magic may once again work in concert towards a better future. The organization is not affiliated with the Horde or the Alliance, instead being a gathering of elves oathbound to unite in trying times.

Skittershaw Spin is a quest achievement earned by riding the High Hollows Skittershaw for a full lap around the district in City of Threads. The Thalassian navy is the maritime military force of the blood elven kingdom of Quel'Thalas. Currently part of the Horde navy, most of their armada is composed of destroyers, powerful warships crewed with highly-skilled elven seafarers and prepared to engage the enemy wherever they might be found. Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore once described their destroyers as faster and lighter than human ships; carrying fewer weapons but compensating with their speed, and therefore as excellent additions to the allied maritime forces during the Second War. Their assets allow the deployment of the Thalassian army across Azeroth.

Torghast: Chorus of Dead Souls was one of the weekly bonus events that provided optional event-exclusive anima powers in a Torghast, Tower of the Damned run. Players will be able to choose the event's anima power from the first Anima Cell along with two normal anima powers. The event cycles with the other two Torghast events, Beasts of Prodigum and Unbridled Darkness, every other week, with the off weeks being a different Bonus Event (e.g. Timewalking). These events are only available in normal Torghast wings and are not available in the Twisting Corridors and Jailer's Gauntlet.

It can be learned after performing 5 transmutations with Midnight Alchemy and then interacting with Camberon's Cauldron in Silvermoon City. Unlocking this recipe requires 3x Stabilized Derivate and 25x Artisan Alchemist's Moxie.

Transit Nexus is a found just north of Wayfarer's Rest in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. The building houses portals to Stormwind City and Orgrimmar. Messenger Aelor's projection can be found outside.

Treasure Wraith is a powerful voidwraith that can be encountered in delves by interacting with a Secret Treasure. Upon defeat, the wraith will leave behind a Lifeblood Crystal with the Essence of Life (delve power) delve power and a Curio Container.

Triumphant Satchel of Champion Mistcrests is the crest upgrade satchel during Midnight Season 2, trading up 30 Veteran Mistcrest for 10 Champion Mistcrest from Vaskarn in Silvermoon City. To purchase this item, it requires the completion of the Veteran of the Mist feat of strength. It contains 10 Champion Mistcrest.

Two of War is created by Darkmoon Card of Draenor. It is also sold by Professor Thaddeus Paleo in Darkmoon Island for . Combining it with the other War cards creates a War Deck, used to create the Skull of War trinket.

Two of Visions is created with the inscription recipe Darkmoon Card of Draenor. It is also sold by Professor Thaddeus Paleo on Darkmoon Island for . Combining it with the other Visions cards creates a Visions Deck, used to create the Winged Hourglass trinket.

Two of Iron is created with the inscription recipe Darkmoon Card of Draenor. It is also sold by Professor Thaddeus Paleo on Darkmoon Island for . Combining it with the other Iron cards creates an Iron Deck, used to create the Knight's Badge trinket.
The Unfinished Sheet Music is found at the southwest part of Silvermoon City. First-time interaction awards 250 reputation with the Silvermoon Court.

Vakthros Summit is an area located in the eastern Azure Span, between the Vakthros Range and the ruins of Vakthros. The name implies it may have once been the summit of the Vakthros mountain range, but during the War against the Primalists, Primalist forces under Raszageth twisted the land with fire and earth, reshaping it to serve as a stronghold. From here, Raszageth sought to destroy Vakthros and thus destabilize the Azure Span, but Kalecgos and the Kirin Tor fought against her, killing her lieutenant Korthrox the Destroyer and disrupting her plans.
Vaeli is a dracthyr found near the Bank of Silvermoon of the Bazaar in Silvermoon City as well as in Founder's Point and Razorwind Shores.

Velhan's Claim is a pair of islands off the northern coast of Hallowfall. It was originally the crash site of the airship Indomitable, but was claimed by its former captain, Duke Velhan, when he retired from the military. He established a settlement with a group of like-minded Arathi who wanted to live a safe life outside of Mereldar. They built a dawntower on the western island's northern end, but the area has recently fallen to the kobyss. The Velhan's Venture skyriding race is at on the northern end of the Sunless Strand island to the east. To purchase this item, it requires the completion of the Adventurer of the Dawn feat of strength. It contains 10 Veteran Dawncrest.

Venerable Satchel of Veteran Mistcrests is the crest upgrade satchel during Midnight Season 2, trading up 30 Adventurer Mistcrest for 10 Veteran Mistcrest from Vaskarn in Silvermoon City. To purchase this item, it requires the completion of the Adventurer of the Mist feat of strength. It contains 10 Veteran Mistcrest.

Venomous Gladiator's Heraldry is a Competitor's Heraldry optional crafting reagent used by Midnight professions to craft Midnight Season 2 PvP gear. Aside from weapons, usually 3, 4, or 5 are required to craft a single piece of gear. They can be bought from Mirvedon and Irissa Bloodstar in Silvermoon City for 175 Conquest. It is also a quest reward from Calling All Combatants!.

The Vicious Moonbeast is an umbraclaw mount that can be purchased for 1 Vicious Saddle from in Stormwind City or from in Orgrimmar. During Dragonflight Season 3, it was earned by winning rated PvP matches while at a rating of 1,000 or higher.

The Wardsmiths are an order of Magisters tasked with maintaining the defenses of Silvermoon City. Their leader, Magister Dawnblaze, inherited the position of High Wardsmith of Silvermoon after the Fourth War claimed the life of her predecessor. The high wardsmith's offices overlook the Gardens of Remembrance.

The Wastelanders are a group of ethereals who have sworn an oath to Nexus-King Salhadaar to destroy the Ravel for what they did to K'aresh. Once known as the K'areshi Oracles prior to the Devouring War, they lead a harsh existence on the shattered planet of K'aresh where survival is a continuous struggle.

Disrupt is an ability available to Support Class Agents in the The Bureau: XCOM Declassified. This ability destroys an enemy's shield and leaves them stunned.

Earth is the third planet from the Sun and is the homeworld of humanity. It is sometimes referred to as "the world" or by its Latin name "Terra." Invaded by powerful alien invaders, the planet must now be defended by the forces of XCOM.

Battle Focus is an ability that William Carter is able to use to direct his fellow Agents in combat situations during the course of The Bureau: XCOM Declassified. This ability slows down the gameplay to a crawl and allows players to give Agents move orders or commands to attack certain enemies with gunfire or abilities.

Ability Points can be used to buy skills for your soldiers in the Training Center: you can purchase any skill available to the soldier's class, as well as a small number of randomly-selected skills from other classes. Skirmishers, Reapers, and Templars have four branches of skills and can acquire the available ones without the Training Center. The Psionic Class is a special sub-class for soldiers in XCOM: Enemy Unknown. Soldiers belonging to any of the principal four classes can access the abilities of this sub-class in addition to the abilities of their base class; however these psi-abilities only unlock for soldiers who possess "The Gift" which is determined by testing in the Psionic Labs. If a soldier unlocks this sub-class, his/her class icon will gain a purple hue to indicate that they are psionic.
General Abilities are a variety of basic abilities and equipment-related abilities available to all soldiers regardless of class in XCOM: Enemy Unknown.
Platform Stability is an inherited MEC Trooper ability in XCOM: Enemy Within. This particular ability is gained if the soldier was originally a Sniper Class.

Any soldier in XCOM 2 and XCOM 2: War of the Chosen can hack mission objectives. The chance of each result is based on the soldier's Hack stat and the enemy's Tech stat (aka Tech score). Notably, only the Specialist, SPARK (DLC), and Reaper (WoTC) may perform hacking attempts of ADVENT Security Towers. The Hack ability (remote hacking with GREMLIN) allows an XCOM Specialist to not only hack primary mission objectives, such as workstations, chests, doors and ADVENT Security Towers remotely, but a variety of additional mechanized units like MECs and Turrets using the Haywire Protocol ability. A Thermo Generator is a facility in XCOM: Enemy Unknown. It produces more power than a regular Power Generator. They serve the same purpose as Power Generators, except it must be constructed on a steam vent.

Training Roulette is a Second Wave option introduced in XCOM: Enemy Within. Each soldier's training tree is mostly randomly generated. Does not apply to MEC Troopers. After a soldier reaches Squaddie rank (receiving a class and their first ability), future ranks will primarily grant randomized abilities from a pool of all the class abilities minus any skills that are dependent on a specific weapon (which remain class locked).

Skill Events are events that reward Ability Points during missions. Some rewards are granted based on an individual soldier's actions (for example, for making a flanking shot); the higher the soldier's Combat Intelligence, the more likely they'll receive the award. Other skill points are granted for major accomplishments, like killing one of the Chosen; these are automatically awarded, but the number of points awarded depends on the soldier's combat intelligence. Skill Events will reward both Ability Points for the soldier that completed the action and the shared pool equally. Aeshma's Core (Japanese: , Aēshuma Koa) is a Boss in . It is fought twice at level 38 at Haggle's Swordtip, atop the Judicium Titan weapon in Temperantia, having been hijacked by Jin. Aeshma's Core is designed by the Ardainians to be used as a defense mechanism. When first encountered, Aeshma's Core automatically restores 25% HP every 2 seconds, essentially nullifying any damage received; instead, the player must focus attacking the level 36 Power Lines. After destroying the Power Lines and the subsequent battle with Jin, the Core loses its healing buff, allowing the party to defeat it. This enemy drops no items.

The Ares 70 (English dub: ) is a Skell in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is one of the strongest non-customized Skells in the game. Its power can be surpassed by a highly customized level 50 or 60 Skell. The stronger variation is the Ares 90. When flying it has the unique effect of phoenix wings sprouting from its Flight Module when boosting instead of the usual jet streams. When moving, it "skates" on the wheels in its feet.

Artifice Aion (Japanese: , Aiōn Debaisu) is the final Boss in , fought at level 70 in the Aion Hangar in the First Low Orbit Station with Malos piloting it. It is the most powerful of the Artifices, with the power to destroy all of Alrest.

The Banquet Hall (Japanese: , Daishokudō) is a location in . It is located on the first floor of Prison Island, west of the Kitchen. It can be accessed via a teleporter from the Central Hall, which is only active on the second visit to Prison Island.

Crane Serpronds (Japanese: , Kurēn Rodon) are enemies in . They are members of the Serprond family. They can be found at level 40 - 44 when Salvaging at the Lascham Island and Torigoth Flower Patch salvage points in the Gormott Province, or at the Goldmouth Flight Deck salvage point in the Argentum Trade Guild during the quest Bana's Secret Treasure. One can also appear randomly during high tide near the Lascham Island salvage point. Although it appears without salvaging, it still behaves as a salvaged enemy, attacking regardless of level difference if the party comes within detection range.
The Corne Island Camp (Japanese: , Korunu-tō no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located on Corne Island in Erythia Sea. The Island Caravan is located here.

Cummings is an NPC in . He is a City Survivor who moves to Colony 9 after being rescued near the Mt. Nagul Viewing Deck on the Black Mountains. Cummings's Community can be gained after talking to him three times, completing Regret and Resolve and Instructor Panacea, and saving all 13 City Survivors.

Deinoses (Japanese: , Dinosu) family is an enemy family in and . They resemble theropod dinosaurs with small, quadrupedal creatures riding on their head, and are found in Makna Forest and Prison Island. They are Sight enemies. Deinoses are notable for appearing under the same name on Prison Island, where most minor enemies unique to the Island. They share this with Laias and Nebulae. They should not be confused with Deinos Sauros; although they share the word "Deinos" in English, their Japanese names are slightly different (, Dinoru vs. , Dinosu).

It is track 14 of disc 3 from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. It plays when a Skell takes flight if the Skell is equipped with the Flight Module. In , the player can swap between this song, Don't worry [2XDv], which is a new rearrangement of this song, and a version of Don't worry [2XDv] without lyrics through the "Skell Flight BGM" setting, with the original version playing when the setting is set to "Original".

The Divine Roost (Japanese: , Kamidori Nedokoro, "Divine Bird's Resting Grounds") is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the northernmost section of Noctilum, and is accessible by Skell with the Flight Module. There are three Tyrants that can be found around here; two can be found flying around the large tree, while one is in it. One of these, Telethia, the Endbringer, is the most powerful enemy in the game. The missing Orpheans can be found here during A Fateful Choice, and Gnarlbranch Sap can be found here during Herbivores, Unite!. It is a body of water located on a massive shelf of land cantilevered above an also-massive void of air above the world's ocean; the sea's water isn't bounded at the edges of the shelf, and flows over the edge as enormous waterfalls. Colony Mu, Colony 15, and the Lost Colony are located here. It is a Hovering Reef, and has five devices similar to windmills on it. It is connected to Hovering Reef 10 by a teleporter. Jarack is the High Entia in charge of the plant, and the only NPC on the island until after the events at the Mechonis Core, when several other High Entia join him. When he is first met, he is fixing one of the windmills, and he gives a few quests related to this. A Heart-to-Heart - "A Gift for a Loved One" - is located here. There are no enemies on this island, except when two Ekidnos appear during Hode Attack.

FN Site 109 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia on an elevated island near the Arendt Bridge, and is easily reached by flight. It can also be reached by jumping from the island north of it using a Skell or gliding through the air with a Hraesvelg. The only enemies here are Crawler Blattas.

The FILE-USP0260SA is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is found in a White Whale wreckage on the highest floating island in Primordia, next to Talon Rock Summit. It requires Field-Skill Mechanical Level 5 and flight capability. This schematic can be used to craft a level 50 Skell Back Superweapon called Zenith-Cannon at the AM Terminal.

A Nebula (Japanese: , Nebura) is a species of monster in and , and includes Novae which are quest-exclusive. They are cloud-like, gaseous enemies made of pure ether found on Bionis' Leg, outside Colony 6, at Satorl Marsh, in Makna Forest, at Eryth Sea, on Valak Mountain, in the Bionis' Interior, and on Prison Island. The most powerful Nebula is the Bagrus Nebula at level 96. All Nebulae have a very high resistance to physical attacks which reduces damage by 80%.

Ocean Balaenas (Japanese: , Ōshan Baraena) are enemies in . They are members of the Balaena family, and can be found at level 60 in Oblivia north of FN Site 305, and level 57-58 on an island in southeast Oblivia Waters. This island is home to Bressole, the Fugitive.

Power Drain (Japanese: , Pawā Dorein) is one of Fiora's Ether status arts in . It reduces the target's Strength by 20%. It also raises Fiora's strength by 20%, plus 5% for each additional enemy after the first.

Power Smash (Japanese: , Pawā Sumasshu) is one of Fiora's early game physical arts in . Damage will triple if the enemy is attacked from behind by using Power Smash. Damage is calculated based on the weapon's attack + Fiora's strength.
The Prison Island Camp (Japanese: , Kangokutō no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located at the top of Prison Island on the Black Mountains, next to the Prison Terrace.

Raguel Lake (Japanese: , Ragueru-ko) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of the Bionis' Leg. There is a bridge crossing it, one large island in it, and some rock platforms rising high out of it. Dark Hoxes and White Hoxes are found on the southern platforms, and Greed Gogols and Gluttony Gogols can be found on the northern ones. Small rope bridges connect these platforms. Several Envy Sardi lurk in the lake near shorelines. When it is night or rains, Light Wisps or Aqua Nebula respectively replace the Envy Sardi. Ultrafauna (Japanese: , Arutimetto) are a category of enemy in . It includes extremely powerful and dangerous species with abilities and strength far beyond most lifeforms. Both Nemeses are Ultrafauna.

Wold is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti and can be found in Grodd Residential Zone in Gormott Province. He offers the Merc Mission Protect the Holy Place. Wold works at a kitchen in Grodd, and he tells the player the story of the Gormott city and fortress which was known as the "White Chair". He says that while Ardainian forces completely destroyed the ancient city, causing Gormott to surrender their province to Mor Ardain, he does not hold the history between races against the current-day citizens.

The 117th Marine Division is a division of the Galaxy Federation's Marine Corps in the Xenosaga series. They and their fleet were put in charge of escorting the cruiser Woglinde in the investigation of the disappearance of the planet Ariadne. To accompany the Woglinde, the fleet includes several Ehime-class destroyers including the Ogetsu, the Odo, and the Takeyori.

The Galaxy Federation Police Station is a major area in Xenosaga: Pied Piper. It is located in the Archon Zone on Planet Abraxas, serving as the Federation Police's headquarters for the city, led by Sean McCallum. It also serves as a base of operations for the 1875th Special Ops Command Abraxas detachment's hunt for the U.M.N. terrorist Voyager. The station is Pied Piper's de facto hub area, as it is the only area the player returns to at various points throughout the game.

At the start of battle, the Naglfar will create a defense shield to reduce damage. Take note of the event slot it deployed the shield, because its power will be reduced when damaged on that event slot. Also, hitting it will reduce the shield's power. A druid trainer is an NPC that offers druids the opportunity to train abilities and reset their talent points. A general rule-of-thumb to find the local Druid trainer is to search the city's more naturalistic areas, such as a park or garden.

Druids of the Talon is a druidic organization affiliated with the Guardians of Hyjal. They used to make their base at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal, but after it was destroyed by the Burning Legion they moved to a new shrine at the northern edge of the Dreamgrove. Before all of the druidic orders coalesced into the Cenarion Circle, the Druids of the Talon were responsible for teaching promising young druids the mysteries of flight. With the dissolution of the order, former members teach the skill sparingly. When hibernating in the Emerald Dream, they are referred to as the Sleeping.

The Druids of the Scythe (originally the Druids of the Pack) are a sect of druids who advocated the use of the Pack Form during the War of the Satyr. They shapeshifted into a powerful yet unwieldy form that embodied the fury of the wolf Ancient Guardian Goldrinn. They called this form the Pack Form, a form that turned them into wolves. Although powerful, the Pack Form tended to turn the druids feral. Malfurion Stormrage prohibited the use of this form because it couldn't be controlled. However, the Druids of the Pack continued to practice the form in secret but eventually lost themselves to the form's feral rage. Dropping Some Eaves is an achievement earned by witnessing a special conversation between Melandrus and Elisande in the Court of Stars. While stated to be achievable on Mythic difficulty, it is also available on Heroic (the lowest mode of Court of Stars). It is generally assumed to be a random occurrence, but the truth is if you satisfy a number of prerequisites, the conversation will trigger.

Drowned Gilnean Spirits are human ghosts that briefly appear in the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.

Drizza Sidestabber is a goblin ghost rogue who can be found kneeling over her own body at Killclaw's Lair on Exile's Reach. She was a member of the first Horde expedition to the island and was working on making a poison to weaken Gutgruk the Tough, who had kidnapped some of the first expedition's members. However, before she could finish, she was presumably killed by Killclaw the Terrible. Drizza was later found by a rogue recruit who had come to the island with the second expedition. She taught them how to create the poison and tasked them with killing Gutgruk in her place. Once the poison was finished and the recruit was ready to take on Gutgruk, Drizza's spirit faded away.
Dro Seminario is an undead located in the Cauldron of Rock in Darkmoon Island.

Dun Morogh (pronounced Dunn Mohr-OH) is a snowy region located between the magma-strewn wasteland of the Searing Gorge to the south, the gentle ridges of Loch Modan to the east, and the swampy Wetlands to the north. Dun Morogh is home to both the gnomes of Gnomeregan and the Ironforge dwarves and is the location of the major city of Ironforge. Mountains surround Dun Morogh on all sides, making it accessible only by certain passes that are currently watched over by dwarven troops.

Dun Mandarr is a small base nearby an icy cavern in south-eastern Winterspring. The camp is overrun by ferocious moonkin and was set up by Jaron Stoneshaper, its dwarven origin obvious from the linguistic qualities of the cave's name. Jaron had discovered a Blue-Feathered Amulet, which enraged the wildkin and caused them to chase Jaron off and destroy his camp.

Dun Morogh Mountaineers are dwarven mountaineers who patrol the roads of Dun Morogh. They can also be seen aiding the gnomes of New Tinkertown in Chill Breeze Valley. They also assisted in the defense of the region during the Legion Invasions. Some of them were mind-controlled by Subjugator Vuur or seen injured.

Duncan's Textiles is a tailoring shop located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City. It is one of the most prominent tailoring shops in the city, and offers a wide range of services from training to supplies. The shop is owned by Duncan Cullen and may be found in the far east of the Mage Quarter, near the exit to the Trade District.

Duality was a pet ability available exclusively to the chimaera family of hunter pets, increasing player multistrike chance by 5%. It is functionally identical to the bat family's Sonic Focus, the wind serpent family's Breath of the Winds, the dragonhawk family's Spry Attacks, and the core hound family's Double Bite, but surpassed in effectiveness by the Wild Strength of the clefthoof family, which provides additional Versatility.

Duskhaven was a town located along the southwestern coast of Gilneas. Gwen Armstead was its mayor. It was the location that the evacuees from Gilneas City fled to as the worgen overran the capital. One day before the attack on Gilneas City, the town witnessed a murder by the Starlight Slasher. With the earthquakes caused by the Cataclysm, the land beneath Duskhaven crumbled, and the town was swallowed by the sea. Its underwater ruins can be visited on the Gilnean coast.

The Durnholde military was the military force garrisoned in Durnholde Keep, under the command of Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore and his second-in-command Karramyn Langston. It was in charge of the protection of the orcish internment camps, trying to stop Thrall's escape and then subsequent liberation of his people. Some of its members wore the white and blue tabard of Lordaeron such as Captain Skarloc, others wore the red and gold livery of Blackmoore's personal troops, while Durnholde's actual garrison wore blue livery. The military was a diverse, powerful force including footsoldiers but also mages, knights, paladins, and flying machines.
